Validate a True-to-Observed Genotype Matrix

Source: R/genotype_misclassification_matrix.R
dot-validate_genotype_misclassification_matrix.Rd

Validate a True-to-Observed Genotype Matrix

Usage

.validate_genotype_misclassification_matrix(M, tolerance = 1e-10)

Arguments

M

Numeric three-by-three matrix with true genotypes in rows and observed genotypes in columns, both ordered 0, 1, 2.

tolerance

Tolerance for row sums, not for detecting zero entries.

Value

The validated matrix, retaining dimensions and dimnames.

Details

An exactly all-zero row is replaced by its corresponding identity row, assuming correct classification for that genotype. One warning is issued per repaired matrix. Small nonzero entries are never treated as zero, and other malformed rows are rejected without normalization.
